Follows Claude Code 2.1.326: desk-look reads parts of files with Claude Code's new ranged `$.fs.read` instead of running `tail`, `head` and `od`, so a background command's output over 4 MiB now shows its last lines.

- **Large background output**: `/desk-tasks` details, the last-line preview in `/desk-activity`, and the check for a finished shell started by a subagent now read only the last 64 KB of the output file. Before, an output file over 4 MiB couldn't be read at all, so the detail said there was no output and a subagent's finished shell kept showing as running
- **Advisor calls**: `/desk-activity` takes this session's transcript path from Claude Code (`$.session.info`) instead of guessing it under `~/.claude/projects`, and reads only the bytes added since the last read, without `tail`
- **Fewer programs run**: `/desk-sessions` reads the start and end of a large session file directly instead of with `head -c` and `tail -c`, and pasted image sizes come from the file's first 24 bytes instead of `od`. The README's list of programs desk-look runs is shorter, and the README now has an install line
- desk-asana, desk-slack, desk-plan and desk-review move to 0.81.4 with only the version range raised

Needs Claude Code 2.1.326 or later.

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
